text: Megabuilding H10 hums with a thousand lives stacked in concrete. Someone's always watching.
Kabuki market neon bleeds across wet pavement; the smell of synth-noodles and ozone.
Corpo plaza glass throws the skyline back at you. Security drones drift like patient sharks.
Arasaka Tower scrapes the smog ceiling. Even the air up here belongs to someone.
Valentino murals watch the street. Family is everything here, and everything has a price.
Half-built resorts rot in the dark. The Voodoo Boys own the wires that still work.
Factory smokestacks and power lines; the industrial heart that the corps bleed dry.
Wind, dust, and solar farms to the horizon. Out here the city's grip finally loosens.
